chunks: From him, from al-Amriki, from Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Musa (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the two rak'ahs of Zuwal (midday) on Friday, before the call to prayer or after it? He said: 'Before the call to prayer.'

key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ الزَّوَالِ: The two rak'ahs of Zuwal (midday prayer)

ai.seo_question: When should the two voluntary prayers of Friday Zuwal be performed relative to the Adhan?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam Musa al-Kadhim (AS), transmitted via the reliable chain of al-Amriki, clarifies the precise timing for the two voluntary rak'ahs of Zuwal on Friday, specifying they are performed before the Adhan. This ruling highlights the distinct jurisprudential status of Friday prayers in Shia fiqh, distinguishing the pre-Adhan voluntary acts from the post-Adhan congregational prayer, thereby emphasizing the importance of adhering to the specific temporal markers of the day's worship.
